physics.action: Unchanged SS OCF1, flat axisymmetric fixed internal direction; no gravity, external pump or center force.

physics.momentum: Independent action-derived stress and moving-worldtube Reynolds terms; disjoint core/exterior partition; absorber E,Q,P sinks plus outer flux without double counting.

stages.exit: All implementation blockers resolved and validation controls pass before any new research evolution.

stages.name: Boundary discriminator and prepared state
stages.exit: Separate boundary location from sponge width; solve the embedded mode and prepare a free joint pair with measured losses/residuals. If no usable preparation within the declared 20-period cap, stop unresolved.

stages.name: 100-period isolated and prepared quiet longevity
stages.exit: Isolated and prepared pair both meet <1% mode-energy loss and flux-corrected charge drift over 100 periods, <1% frequency/jitter and distinctness with independent controls. Every failure/unresolved result blocks sources.
tests: Isolated and pair base/refined h with dt fixed
Independent dt/2, larger box at fixed sponge width, sponge-width-only controls for isolated and pair
Three-grid extension if needed for contraction; include its additional cost before launch
Pair benchmark envelope includes up to 20 preparation periods plus 100 measurement periods; isolated measurement 100

stages.name: Bounded source-only and independent receiver feasibility

tests: At most3 compact neutral and3 compact structural candidate preparations, saved whether useful or not; numerical variants are not additional physical candidates
Derive finite-beam canonical initial data; measure invariant forcing, sector spectra, energy and momentum at prospective receiver surface
Structural spectrum above vacuum mass threshold1; a=pi_a=0 remains exact
Neutral plane-wave invariant null and finite-beam/scattering response assessed, no inserted evolution source
Freeze deterministic candidate selection rule, source support, amplitudes, propagation/settling windows and calibration hashes before any held-out B history is seen

stages.name: Held-out neutral and structural acceptance matrix
stages.exit: Execute every mandatory comparison and numerical control, retain all outcomes. Primary neutral reception/recoil/survival must pass; structural channel may yield a converged null. Incomplete matrix remains unresolved.

Third spatial grid for quiet, neutral nominal, structural plus/minus =4 more; extend to any other claim lacking contraction
Output/event sampling and worldtube/extraction placement refined independently from sufficiently dense saved data; add evolution/replay if saved data are inadequate
Actual duration = ceil((predicted last arrival + settling)/calibrated period)+20 periods; 30 periods is a cost illustration, never an imposed cutoff

gates.name: Provenance and prerequisites
gates.pass_if: Verify exact model, configuration, calibration and Test 6/7 canonical identities; accept spatial calibration and prepared quiet pair; lock all source-only choices before held-out pair evolution.
gates.fail_if: Identity mismatch, invalid evidence or failed prerequisite.
gates.unresolved_if: Missing full predecessor evidence, pending preparation, unregistered runtime, or unlocked prospective choices.
gates.uncertainty: Use the additive deterministic error budget; omit no relevant numerical contribution.

gates.name: Physical preparation
gates.pass_if: Finite energy and positive Z; initially distinct cores; compact source differences; all relaxation and initial excitation energy/momentum saved; zero evolution-time external work.
gates.fail_if: Nonfinite/unhealthy state, unaccounted work, overlapping identity, or initial receiver change outside compact source support.
gates.unresolved_if: Joint preparation or its uncertainty is not established.
gates.uncertainty: Use the additive deterministic error budget; omit no relevant numerical contribution.

gates.name: Local reception
gates.pass_if: Primary neutral |Delta N_B| > 5 epsilon_N on accepted refined results; contracting spatial errors, independent budgets and no pre-arrival record above its bound.
gates.fail_if: Resolved acausal record or failed mandatory numerical control.
gates.unresolved_if: Signal does not exceed five budgets or refinement cannot distinguish it from zero.
gates.uncertainty: Use the additive deterministic error budget; omit no relevant numerical contribution.

gates.name: Recoil
gates.pass_if: Primary neutral |delta P_B_z| > 5 epsilon_P relative to matched quiet; independently integrated stress impulse and worldtube momentum agree within combined budget; mirror reverses impulse.
gates.fail_if: Inconsistent flux signs, resolved mismatch or artificial center force.
gates.unresolved_if: Unresolved impulse or missing independent stress/worldtube account.
gates.uncertainty: Use the additive deterministic error budget; omit no relevant numerical contribution.

gates.name: Ledgers
gates.pass_if: Global energy and matched intervention energy residual/injected energy <1%; momentum residual/nonzero declared momentum scale <1%; absolute ledger uncertainty <20% of receiver impulse throughout interval.
gates.fail_if: Any required residual exceeds its limit or energy/rest-mass normalization hides the signal.
gates.unresolved_if: Zero/undefined normalization, missing sink/flux term or unresolved absolute impulse budget.
gates.uncertainty: Use the additive deterministic error budget; omit no relevant numerical contribution.

gates.name: Survival
gates.pass_if: Both distinct localized clocks retain readable quadratures and ordered ticks for >=20 calibrated signed-field periods after passage/settling; >=99% post-settling mode energy, >=90% preinteraction mode energy at end of interaction, <1% flux-corrected charge drift, <1% frequency deviation and jitter.
gates.fail_if: Core loss/merger, ambiguous ticks, or resolved violation of an energy/charge/frequency/jitter limit.
gates.unresolved_if: Missing 20-period follow-up, insufficient mode isolation or tracking precision.
gates.uncertainty: Use the additive deterministic error budget; omit no relevant numerical contribution.

gates.name: Mechanism controls
gates.pass_if: Exact unseeded neutral null at validated arithmetic floor; any leakage converges below record budget; neutral whole-field sign parity within combined errors; amplitude, clock-phase, removed-object and quiet controls classified; raw invariant forcing and density/clock histories saved.
gates.unresolved_if: Omitted or unresolved mandatory control; unresolved quadratic scaling is not forced to pass.
gates.uncertainty: Use the additive deterministic error budget; omit no relevant numerical contribution.

gates.name: Structural companion
gates.pass_if: Perturbed-core a=pi_a=0 and opposite perturbation evaluated with quiet/source-only/numerical controls; classify emission, local response and recoil with errors. A converged channel null/upper bound is allowed.
gates.fail_if: Failed physical/numerical control or spurious neutral production.
gates.unresolved_if: Unresolved emission/reception/recoil classification or missing companion control.
gates.uncertainty: Use the additive deterministic error budget; omit no relevant numerical contribution.

gates.name: Numerical reliability
gates.pass_if: Independent space/time/domain/sponge/output/extraction/preparation controls; three spatial levels for primary observables and any additional case needing contraction; pre-causal precursors shrink below budgets.
gates.fail_if: Noncontracting resolved error, causal contamination or failed reliability check.
gates.unresolved_if: Incomplete independent errors, inadequate sampling or uncertain embedding/tracking.
gates.uncertainty: Use the additive deterministic error budget; omit no relevant numerical contribution.

gates.name: Handoff
gates.pass_if: Canonical and reader verify; all required figures and exact data; persistent event IDs, worldlines, proper times, coframes/basis transport and restartable fields/momenta; supported boost v=0.1 reconstruction slab passes withheld-sample checks; readiness true only if G0-G8 and artifacts pass.
gates.unresolved_if: Missing reconstruction coverage, export/recovery validation or any unresolved gate.
gates.uncertainty: Use the additive deterministic error budget; omit no relevant numerical contribution.

matrix.additional_third_grid_rule: Add the third grid to every other nonzero or null-bound claim whose contraction remains unresolved; cost is additional.
matrix.duration_rule: 20 post-settling signed periods plus prospectively predicted last-arrival and settling interval; extend for massive group delay and larger separation. 30 is a lower planning example.

calibration.third_grid: Required if spatial contraction remains unresolved; not included in the initial cost envelope.

pilot.selection_rule: Choose one neutral and one structural preparation using source-only flux/spectra and independent spatial receiver calibration, maximizing the smaller conservative predicted phase/impulse margin subject to survival. Tie: least excitation energy. No resolvable primary neutral candidate ends the stage unresolved; no further tuning on held-out B.
must_freeze_before_pilot: Compact bump support, carrier/spectrum and field/canonical momentum formula for each candidate
Candidate amplitudes from an independent weak-response and finite-energy calculation
Sampling surfaces, duration and signal/impulse/survival uncertainty budgets
must_freeze_before_acceptance: Accepted prepared states and embedded modes with hashes
Exactly chosen sources, amplitudes, relative phases, separation and mirrored/removed-object mapping
Causal/marker/settling windows, worldtubes, output cadence, all numerical variants, physical normalization scales
Runtime config, registered experiment and source hashes; every figure question

resources.estimate_method: Measured sequential case wall time * target cell count/reference cell count * target steps/reference steps; choose measured fine or timestep-controlled pair reference. Single-core wall is a CPU-equivalent proxy, not an instrumented CPU measurement. No parallel or accelerator speedup assumed.
limitations: Full stress/tracking/checkpoint/observer diagnostics overhead is unmeasured.
Fine-grid cache/memory effects are not linear; third-grid scaling is only a planning proxy.
All source support/arrival/settling choices may increase the duration; preparation/eigenmode solvers are not timed.
Two-times wall headroom is a scheduling allowance, not a statistical confidence interval.

error_budget.rule: epsilon_O=sum of absolute relevant independent changes plus calibration/preparation, extraction/tracking and sampling errors; no quadrature sum without justified statistical independence.
